title: Chip
description: A pill-shaped toggle for filters and tags. Neutral when off; active uses the high-contrast surface, with colour only on its dot or icon (tone).
when: Several filters that can be on at once (materials, device types).
Removable active filters above a list.
a11y: A button with aria-pressed when it toggles; keep the text short.

examples.title: Toggle filters
examples.description: tone colours the dot of what the chip filters; the chip itself stays neutral.
